## Notes

MoveSmart Zigbee DIN rail circuit breaker with power monitoring, 220V.

### Re-pair / starting pairing mode again

Long press for 15 seconds to enter pairing mode.

### Functions

- Remote Control ON/OFF
- Reclosing
- Energy Monitoring
- Adjustable Current Limit (1–63 A)
- Adjustable Overcurrent Protection
